description: `tmux kill-session` on the pane running a bounded codex exec. The whole process tree dies: the stream stops after turn.started, no result file, and the exit-code wrapper never runs.
argv: # pane ran: codex exec --json --skip-git-repo-check -o RESULT 'reply with the single word OK' </dev/null >EVENTS 2>ERR; printf %s $? > RC
notes: no RC file is produced, so a consumer sees: tmux gone + no turn.completed + no rc => terminated
contrast with exec_killed_sigkill.jsonl, where SIGKILL to the parent pid only leaves an orphan behind
